CORRIGENDUM & ADDENDUM
Notice No. NMS/2026/01-CORR. Date: 02 February 2026.
Issuing Authority: Ministry of Education & National Scholarship Board, New Delhi.
Subject: Corrigendum to Notification No. NMS/2026/01 dated 10 Jan 2026.

In partial modification to Advertisement No. NMS/2026/01 dated 10 Jan 2026, the competent authority has approved the following amendments:

1. Extension of Application Deadline:
In view of representations received from candidates, the last date for online submission of applications is hereby extended to 28 February 2026, 11:59 PM.

2. Revision of Qualifying Percentage:
The minimum qualifying marks for OBC candidates is revised to 60% aggregate. For General candidates, the minimum qualifying marks remains 65% aggregate.

3. Payment Mode:
Applicants can now also pay fees via UPI in addition to Net Banking and Debit Card.

All other terms, age limits, and conditions stipulated in the base notice dated 10 Jan 2026 remain unchanged.
